requirements.desc: When an AI reads the flow skill's Worktree boundary partial during an active worktree flow, the partial shall contain a MUST line prohibiting the use of main repo absolute paths as the file-path argument to Edit/Write tool calls.
requirements.note: Added new MUST bullet in src/templates/partials/worktree-mode.md explicitly forbidding main repo absolute paths for Edit/Write file-path arguments.

requirements.desc: When R1's MUST line is read, it shall explicitly list both allowed alternatives: (a) a relative path from the worktree cwd, and (b) an absolute path under the `worktreePath` obtained via `sdd-forge flow get resolve-context`.
requirements.note: Same new MUST bullet explicitly lists both alternatives: relative path from worktree cwd and absolute path under worktreePath from `sdd-forge flow get resolve-context`.

requirements.desc: When the project adds this change, a new unit test file at `tests/unit/templates/worktree-mode.test.js` shall exist and, when `npm test` is run, shall assert the presence of the characteristic keywords of R1/R2 (at minimum 'main repo' and 'worktreePath') in the partial file and pass with a zero exit code.
requirements.note: New file tests/unit/templates/worktree-mode.test.js exists, includes assertions for 'main repo' and 'worktreePath', and flow metadata in diff reports npm test exitCode 0.

requirements.desc: When this change is applied, the three existing MUST lines in the Worktree boundary partial (`cd` prohibition, `git stash`/`reset --hard` prohibition, baseline comparison via detached worktree) shall remain unchanged.
